behavioral_notes.observation: state Selection is new(To Order)->ordered->sent(to supplier)->confirmed(Received), plus cancelled. action_order validates supplier availability + product active, writes state='ordered' and calls _check_wallet; action_send sets 'sent'; action_confirm sets 'confirmed'; action_cancel sets 'cancelled'. create()/write() merge a duplicate same user/product/date/note/toppings line by incrementing quantity instead of inserting a new row. Not visible in metadata.

Wallet is not a stored field: get_wallet_balance sums lunch.cashmove.report amounts for the user (search_read) then adds company.lunch_minimum_threshold (an allowed overdraft credit). cashmoves are two-sided -- a payment (credit) topped up by a manager and an order (debit). _check_wallet flushes then raises ValidationError when balance < 0, blocking ordering. The /lunch/pay and /lunch/payment_message routes drive the top-up UX. Computed in Python, not metadata.

Each supplier owns a per-record ir.cron created in create() and kept in sync by _sync_cron (nextcall = automatic_email_time in supplier tz). When send_by='mail' the cron fires _send_auto_email which aggregates today's 'ordered' orders for that vendor, groups them per lunch.location, renders the lunch.lunch_order_mail_supplier template to the vendor, then calls orders.action_send() (state->sent). action_send_orders / action_confirm_orders are the manual dashboard buttons. supplier.write() also cascades active/company changes onto related lunch.product and lunch.order rows. Cross-model + scheduler side-effects invisible to metadata.

Backend OWL client (web.assets_backend) with 7 components -- LunchDashboard (static/src/components/lunch_dashboard.js) plus LunchOrderLine, LunchUser, LunchLocation, LunchCurrency, LunchAlert(s) -- a custom kanban/list (views/kanban.js, views/list.js, lunch_renderer_mixin.js) and a lunch_is_favorite_field widget; 7 JS files, 4 XML templates. This UX layer is not represented in Python model metadata.

information_flows: side-effect: lunch.order.action_order -> state 'ordered' + lunch.cashmove wallet check (ValidationError if negative)
side-effect: lunch.supplier._send_auto_email (cron) -> aggregate today's orders + email vendor + orders.action_send (state 'sent')
side-effect: lunch.supplier.write(active/company) -> cascade onto lunch.product + lunch.order

value_streams: Order-to-Meal: browse product -> place order (new) -> internal order (ordered) -> sent to vendor (sent) -> received (confirmed), wallet debited
policies: 10 record rules: own-orders / own-cashmoves visibility for users, manager-wide access; multi-company scoping on suppliers/products/locations
wallet minimum-threshold overdraft + negative-balance block on ordering
per-supplier ir.cron automatic vendor email at the configured deadline

classification.rationale: lunch is an internal HR employee-services / perk: it lets staff order meals, tracks a per-employee wallet (lunch.cashmove) against a company minimum threshold, and brokers aggregated orders to caterers. It produces no externally sold output and creates no chain document flow (no stock/account postings) -- it is a cross-cutting support activity administering an employee benefit, hence value_model 'support' and APQC 7.0 (Develop and Manage Human Capital / employee well-being & services).

standard_capabilities: employee meal ordering with product catalog, categories and toppings/extras
order lifecycle new->ordered->sent->confirmed with duplicate-line merge
per-employee prepaid wallet via lunch.cashmove + configurable minimum threshold
supplier management with automatic daily order email (per-supplier cron) and manual send/confirm
lunch locations, favorites, new-until badges, and time-windowed availability alerts
typical_fits: standard cafeteria/catering ordering for an office
manager tops up wallets; employees self-order from the OWL dashboard
phone vs email vendor ordering toggled per supplier
common_gaps: payroll deduction / accounting integration for wallet balances (no link to account or hr.payslip out of the box)
online vendor APIs or external food-ordering platforms (no HTTP/SDK integration)
approval workflow or per-employee subsidy/budget rules beyond the flat minimum threshold
drive_hints: curl jsonrpc /lunch/infos (auth=user) to load the dashboard payload
